note.en: A chapter a night, all winter. Halfway, and Pierre still has no idea what he wants.
note.fr: Un chapitre par soir, tout l’hiver. À mi-chemin, et Pierre ne sait toujours pas ce qu’il veut.

books.title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
books.author: Jules Verne

note.en: Nemo’s library aboard the Nautilus is the real hero.
note.fr: Le vrai héros, c’est la bibliothèque du Nautilus.

note.en: Skipped none of the whaling chapters. Proud of that.
note.fr: Je n’ai sauté aucun chapitre sur la chasse. J’en suis fier.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
books.quote: Beware; for I am fearless, and therefore powerful.

note.en: The creature argues better than anyone else in the book.
note.fr: La créature argumente mieux que tout le monde dans ce livre.

books.title: Dracula
books.author: Bram Stoker
books.quote: Listen to them, the children of the night. What music they make!

note.en: Told in letters and diaries, so it reads like a case file.
note.fr: Raconté en lettres et en journaux : on lit un dossier d’enquête.

books.title: Wuthering Heights
books.author: Emily Brontë
books.quote: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.

note.en: Everyone is awful and I could not stop.
note.fr: Tout le monde est odieux et je n’ai pas pu m’arrêter.

books.title: The Awakening
books.author: Kate Chopin
books.quote: The voice of the sea is seductive.

note.en: Short, and it stays with you for weeks.
note.fr: Court, et il reste en tête des semaines.

note.en: Becky Sharp runs circles around the narrator.
note.fr: Becky Sharp mène le narrateur par le bout du nez.

books.title: The Portrait of a Lady
books.author: Henry James
books.quote: I always want to know the things one shouldn’t do.

note.en: Slow, then the last hundred pages hit all at once.
note.fr: Lent, puis les cent dernières pages frappent d’un coup.

note.en: Read it for the sentences. Flaubert rewrote each one for days.
note.fr: À lire pour les phrases : Flaubert passait des jours sur chacune.

note.en: Stranger and funnier than the musical.
note.fr: Plus étrange et plus drôle que la comédie musicale.

books.title: The Lost World
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.quote: There are heroisms all round us waiting to be done.

note.en: Pure adventure. Challenger is a magnificent menace.
note.fr: Aventure pure. Challenger est une menace magnifique.

note.en: Read aloud, a book at a time. It is meant to be heard.
note.fr: Lu à voix haute, un chant à la fois. C’est fait pour être entendu.

note.en: Argued with it in the margins the whole way.
note.fr: J’ai argumenté dans les marges du début à la fin.

books.title: Little Women
books.author: Louisa May Alcott
books.quote: I’m not afraid of storms, for I’m learning how to sail my ship.

books.title: A Study in Scarlet
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.quote: There’s the scarlet thread of murder running through the colourless skein of life.

books.title: The Sign of the Four
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.quote: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.

note.en: The moor does half the work.
note.fr: La lande fait la moitié du travail.

books.title: Walden; or, Life in the Woods
books.author: Henry David Thoreau

note.en: Read on a porch, which felt like cheating.
note.fr: Lu sur une galerie, ce qui ressemblait à de la triche.
